name: showreel-c3-text-on-photo

voice.text: This poster is hard to read. The photo is too busy. Turns out, words need calm behind them. First, dim the photo. Next, make the words bold. Then put the date on a band. Now it reads from across the street.

caption:
This poster is hard to read. White words sit straight on a busy photo. 🎤

1. Dim the photo. A dark layer gives the words calm behind them.
2. Make the words bold. Thin letters melt into bright light; heavy ones hold.
3. Put the small print on a solid band. A flat colour is easier to read than any photo.

Save this for your next poster, flyer or story. Which fix would you try first?
